QuoteProvider.reason: Prices and splits from Yahoo Finance; the Yahoo adapter (#6) fills quotes, splits, dividends and assets.

DividendProvider.reason: Dividends from Yahoo Finance; the Yahoo adapter (#6) fills them with the quotes.

FundamentalsProvider.reason: Yearly fundamentals from StatusInvest; the adapter is built (#8)

StatementProvider.reason: Financial statements from CVM ITR and DFP; the CVM statements adapter (#11) fills them per company, with the consolidated and individual versions. A load needs a CNPJ for the ticker, which no source gives yet.

FundDataProvider.reason: Monthly FII data from StatusInvest; the adapter is built (#8)

FilingProvider.reason: Filing list from the CVM IPE file (#9); a load of a ticker fails with a named error until a source maps tickers to CNPJ.

DocumentProvider.reason: Filing documents (PDF and HTML) from CVM through www.rad.cvm.gov.br; the CVM document adapter (#10) downloads them per filing, with a size limit and a host list. FNET documents come with #12.

MacroProvider.reason: Macro series from BCB SGS; the BCB adapter (#7) fills ipca, cdi, selic and ptax.
